items.title: Bitcoin on track for seventh straight weekly loss as ETF outflows hit record

items.title: Bitcoin Heads For Longest Weekly Losing Streak Since 2022 With BlackRock’s IBIT Clocking Record Outflows

items.title: “Such A Funny Idea.” Jeff Bezos’ $41 Billion Startup Could Drive “Civilizational Wealth,” But He Doesn’t See Merging It With Amazon “Right Now”
items.summary: Asked whether his AI startup would fold into Amazon and Blue Origin, Jeff Bezos laughed it off, then chose his words carefully. One short phrase in his answer hints the door may not be shut for good.

items.title: Nvidia’s financing risks could keep AI chip stocks under pressure, analyst says
items.summary: Investing.com -- Nvidia’s troubled effort to mobilize financing for its customers could weigh on the broader AI semiconductor sector, according to Lynx Equity Strategies analyst KC Rajkumar, who cautioned that cheaper valuations alone may not be enough to lure investors back.
